crossRefs.note: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of…
all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
Joab gave up the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand…
This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.
translations.bsb: The Israelites, apart from Benjamin, mobilized 400,000 swordsmen, each one an experienced warrior.
translations.kjv: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.
translations.asv: And the men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.
